name: code-improver
description: User-started review-and-fix loop over one directory: a reviewer you name (any installed review skill or agent) reports into a findings ledger kept under $TMPDIR, a scoped fixer agent repairs the blocking findings, a content-hash guard halts on any edit outside the agreed scope, oscillating findings go back to you, and the run counts as converged only after a clean re-review and a checked finalize pass. Never commits or pushes.
